9. The Ld. AR for the workmen has argued that Auxiliary Nurse Midwives (ANMs) are entitled to grant the Pay Band-II and Pay Grade of Rs. 4200/- w.e.f. 01.01.2006 onwards with all consequential benefits.
Their main contention is that the ANMs are POIT No. 540/2016 page 7 of 15 performing the same nature of work as Staff Nurses and they also fulfill qualifications of Staff Nurses.

10. Per-contra, it has been argued by the ld. AR for the management that the present dispute is not an industrial dispute; the hospital employees union has no locus to raise the present dispute and the same has not been properly espoused; that the ANMs do not fulfill the recruitment rules applicable to staff nurses and both posts are entirely different having completely different promotional channels.

It is submitted that the duties performed by the ANMs and the Staff Nurses are entirely different and the management has detailed in its written statement the different duties that are performed by the two cadres.
The management has also appended charts indicating the promotional channels of ANMs and Staff Nurses which clearly indicate the difference.

 Duties & Responsibilities of 'A' Grade Staff Nurse are summarized as follows :
(i) Admits and discharges the patients.
(ii) Maintain personal hygiene and comforts of the patient.
(iii) Attends to the nutritional needs of the patient, prepares diet and feeds helpless patients.
(iv) Maintains clean and safe environment for the patients.
(v) Implements and maintains ward policies and routines.

(vi) Co-ordinates patient care with various health team members, follows doctors'
rounds.

POIT No. 540/2016 page 10 of 15 (vii) Performs technical task, e.g. administration of medication, assisting doctors in various medical procedures, preparing articles and the patient for medical or Nursing procedures, recording vital signs, tube feeding, giving enema, bowel wash dressing,
stomach wash, eye and ear care, collection and sending of specimens, pre and post operative care, assists in administration of transfusion, perineal care, breast care,
baby care, etc.

(viii) CPR of patient as paramedics care.

16. As detailed above, the cadre and duties of the ANMs as well as of Staff Nurses are different and the same are not in conformity with each other.
In this regard, the workmen in their evidence have not placed on record any fact which could confirm the same.
In fact, the workmen witness WW1 has admitted that " It is correct that cadres of ANMs and Staff Nurse are different ".

Even POIT No.
540/2016 page 13 of 15 otherwise, the aforementioned duties have not been disputed by the workmen.
As such, it is further strengthened by the record that the hierarchical promotional channels of the two cadres are different as are the recruitment rules.
Even otherwise the recruitment rules especially essential qualification also indicate that the qualifications of the two cadres are different.
17. The workmen have further admitted the duties of and responsibilities of ANMs and Staff Nurse.
It is also admitted that in the cadre of A Grade Staff Nurse, the post of A Grade Staff Nurse is the initial post and its promotional channel is as per Ex. WW1/M1, which is Hierarchical Chart.
WW-1 further admitted that Ex. WW1/M2 are the recruitment rules of ANMs, which further proves that the posts are not equivalent.
18. It is important to note here that qualification of both the post i.e. Auxiliary Nurse and A Grade Staff Nurse is totally different.
Further the nature of work as well as manner of their recruitment are also different.
It is further observed that their cadre, promotional avenues as well as recruitment rules are totally different.
There is nothing similar in both the posts.

19. So in absence of any material indicating that the duties and cadre of the ANM as well as Staff Nurses being the same, this Tribunal cannot grant promotion or order to fix their salary in Pay Band - II and Pay Grade of Rs. 4200/- based on the same.
Since the workmen have failed to prove their case on merit, hence, this Tribunal does not deem it fit to decide other issues.

The award is passed accordingly.
